text:
Maya: Heads up — preparing v1.12.0 release tomorrow. Need owners for version pin, docs smoke, and QA signoffs. Branch is `release/1.12.0`. Anyone take ownership? @Oliver @Jen
Oliver: I can take the version bump + changelog. Will open a PR in a few minutes.
Jen: I'll handle docs smoke and release notes wording once the PR is up. Ping me.
Toni: QA can run a quick smoke pass on staging, ~30m. Can someone paste the smoke checklist link?
Maya: Checklist: https://redwood.team/ops/release-smoke-checklist — short items only (generation, streaming, embeddings, auth). Oliver, please use `./scripts/bump-version 1.12.0` and add a short changelog bullet under `docs/CHANGELOG.md`. Example snippet:
```
- 1.12.0: route multiplexing + improved cache eviction. (PR #1234)
```
Oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4987 — includes version bump and a draft changelog. @Jen PTAL.
Jen: LGTM on notes, left one nit about phrasing in the changelog. Also opened docs PR for the code examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/210
qa-automation: Kicked off smoke on staging: tests include basic generation, streaming, embeddings, auth. I'll post failures inline.
release-bot: smoke-run triggered by @qa-automation — https://ci.redwood.com/job/smoke/456 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
security: Quick reminder — if the PR adds deps run `./tools/dep-check` and tag me. Oliver, does this add any new packages?
Oliver: No new deps. Ran `./tools/dep-check` locally, all green. Pushed signed commit.
Maya: Once QA passes can we get final sign-off from product + release owners? Plan to cut at 16:00 UTC. If there are blockers escalate to me.
qa-automation: Smoke run: 3 timing flakes, rerunning with +100ms timeouts. Will update in ~10m.
Toni: I'll own the cutover checklist at release time and monitor telemetry.
Jen: Docs smoke passed. Merged a minor formatting fix.
release-bot: smoke-run finished: 78 tests, 75 passed, 3 flaky -> 2 retried -> all passed. Report: https://ci.redwood.com/job/smoke/456/report :white_check_mark:
Maya: Perfect. Oliver, merge after CI and then I'll trigger the cut. @Toni are you set for the canary plan?
Toni: Ready. Canary: route 10% for 10m, then 50% for 15m, then full — will watch error-rate, p99 latency, and token cost.
Oliver: Merged and tagged `v1.12.0`. Changelog and release notes deployed to /releases.
Maya: Product final call — @Sam give a quick go/no-go? If no objections by 15:45 UTC we'll proceed.
Sam: Go for it from product side. :thumbsup:
Maya: Releasing at 16:00 UTC. Thanks everyone — I'll post a short post-release checklist after cut (smoke summary, rollback notes, docs link).
